text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I devised a new training method based on the overseas insights Mei Satake shared with me.
And it led to an unprecedented discovery!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to my time spent with her, someone who truly knows the world,
I feel as though my own horizons have broadened considerably.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a coincidence. You heading back too?
choice_data_list: No, I was thinking of finishing up some work before heading back.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, came up with a bright idea, did you?
Too late for that now. Call it a day and get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
――Though telling you to rest wouldn't suit you, would it?
You and I are cut from the same cloth, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
All right! How about this, then?
If you're that eager to "work,"
would you care to join me for a meal?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Going out to eat with someone in my position is basically work.
It's practically overtime, overtime!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Besides, eating something delicious might give you
even better ideas.
choice_data_list: I see…… That could work too.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
This is a regular haunt of mine.
You can enjoy some fantastic European-style seafood here.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: The oysters are especially delicious. Just don't go eating too many raw ones, alright?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It's my treat today!
I'm the one who invited you, so don't hold back, got it?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Well now, you've really transformed, haven't you!
You're beyond comparison to how you were three years ago.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You've got the face of a true Trainer now.
The face of someone who guides dreams and romance! Yup!
choice_data_list: Wh-What's the matter all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Heh, don't look so shocked.
I was just saying what was on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Seeing our juniors with bright futures grow makes me happy, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: At first, for better or worse, you seemed like just an ordinary Trainer, though.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Harboring grand ideals far beyond one's reach, while being battered by one's own shortcomings and the harsh realities of the world, spending day after day driven forward—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
What made you extraordinary was that no matter the circumstances,
you never gave up on your dreams and romance.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It's the same for <chrname>.
She's grown tremendously over these past three years, hasn't she?
choice_data_list: Yes…… And I'm going to grow even more!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Oh, big words!
Now I've really got something to look forward to.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You're running alongside a girl carrying huge romantic dreams.
There'll be tough times, but—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, I know you can reach
even greater victories!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Ah. I did notice you were packing away quite a few raw oysters, but...
you feeling all right?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You don't look even remotely okay!
Your face is totally pale.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I never get tired of watching you.
Looking after you is almost genuinely fun.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's all part of the experience.
Nobody starts out completely perfect and fully fledged.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Get plenty of rest today,
Trainer <username>.
And starting again tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Embrace the romance of it all and keep moving forward.
